notes.title: Exclusive in game inventory item for newsletter subscribers!
notes.content:
Prepare yourself for Legends of Castile adventure game and get an exclusive inventory item in the game!


[h1]What is Legends of Castile?[/h1]

Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It tells the story of a village girl (María de Salazar) who must investigate the myths and legends of Castile to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun. Advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meeting all kinds of characters, defeating fantastic creatures with your wit, and exploring places all around Castile.


[h1]What awaits you as a member?[/h1]

Immediate Reward: Sign up now and you will get an exclusive object in María's inventory!.
Artistic Introductions & Lore: Be the first to discover new art of the game and insights from the development.
Early Access Testing: You will be invited to our Discord community member, where you’ll have the unique opportunity to test early versions of the game.
Monthly Digests: Our updates are a curated selection of meaningful developments in the game, ensuring you’re informed without the clutter of spam.

[h1]Crowdfunding with Kickstarter soon[/h1]

We will tell you in with a newsletter when the campaign starts, it will be very soon! Be sure to sign up!
 

Don’t miss out on this epic tale set against the backdrop of historic Spain. Sign up to our newsletter now and become a part of María’s legendary journey!


[url=https://legendsofcastile.us8.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=492e957a11fdc6181073403ec&id=dc67e56fed]Sign up to our newsletter here![/url]

notes.title: Legends of Castile goes to Steam Scream!
notes.content:
Hello fellow adventurers!

We are making a point and click adventure which is called Legends of Castile. It is a fantasy and comedy point and click adventure set in Spain in the 19th century, in the region known as Castile, which is about a village girl who has to investigate the folk legends of Castile to fulfill her dream, to become a nun.

[previewyoutube=W9JYmJ2AkZo;full][/previewyoutube]

Is that intriguing enough for you? Well, we have more insights about the spooky story:

The main character of this adventure is María, a young, fearless, though clumsy Castilian girl. The story begins when just after a long night with her friends she has a vision of the Virgin Mary, after which she decides to become a nun. To do this, María goes to a convent in Burgos to become a nun. However, in order to fulfill this dream, her future mother superior assigns her a very important mission. María will have to investigate the mythological creatures that have been appearing around Castile, and collect an item from each of them to prove their existence so the abbot will take action and end his threat against the population of Castile... and Christianity. In Legends of Castile you can advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meet all kinds of characters, defeat mythological creatures using your wit, and explore picturesque places throughout Castile.

Not sure if this could be your game yet? let us show you some features of the game:

- Lateral logic adventure puzzles, with a smooth difficulty curve, no dead ends or deaths, just fun.
- Female main character.
- Classic frame by frame animation, with lip syncing.
- An original story full of fantasy, humor and Spanish folk legends and myths to discover.
- Not too explicit references to the adventure game classics.
- Inspired by classic adventures like Monkey Island and Broken Sword.
- More than 30 characters and mythological creatures to interact with.
- Around 50 picturesque scenes hand-drawn with paper and pencil and digitally colored in full HD resolution.
- Hundreds of objects to inspect, combine and use in the adventure.
- No panel/mechanical exogenous adventure puzzles (guaranteed!).
- One button interface with 3 contextual verbs which provides more experimentation and fun.
- An Original soundtrack and music pieces of Castilian folk music.

With all this, we hope to be able to convince you to wishlist the game, that will came out on 2024. However, we have something even better, during Steam Scream you will be able to play a demo of the game! Starting now you can play a game demo and experience the spooky folk creatures from Castile in a 30min - 1h demo!

If you try the demo, please tell us what do you think about it!, here are our social media and Discord server, so you can give us first hand feedback and even try beta versions of our game!

[url=https://discord.gg/yC3KgcQ5Nk]Discord server[/url]

[url=https://www.instagram.com/legendsofcastile_game]instagram[/url]

notes.title: Legends of Castile dev stream
notes.content:
Let's play! Come and watch the developer playing the demo of the game and have a taste of what you can expect of the demo before trying it by yourself!

An updated demo is available now for Steam Next Fest with English and Spanish voice over and UI improvements! 

[h3]Dialogues voice over[/h3]


We are very pleased to announce that the demo has now voice over in English and Spanish in dialogues and monologues of the demo, which is a great achievement for such a small indie project like this, and we want to thank every single actor and actress that has forms part in the cast, for their great interpretation and kindness.


[h3]French language revision[/h3]

A revision of French texts has been done by DMT Rétro Gaming.


[h3]UI improvements[/h3]

Several improvements have been performed to the UI of the game. One of them is that in the inventory, now players will be able to look at the objects with only left click, as a look icon appears when hovering each item. The intention of this is that the user is more aware that they can (It is important for puzzles) look at the objects at the inventory screen, and being consistent with a one button interface.


Other minor UI improvements have been done in the menu of the game, like context aware popups.


[h3]Bug fixing[/h3]

Several bugs that the community has found in the previous demo have been corrected. If players found any, or want to be more informed about the game, they can join our Discord server.

[url=https://discord.gg/yC3KgcQ5Nk]Legends of Castile Discord[/url]


[h3]The important part[/h3]

Steam Next Fest is about playing demos and wish list games. We invite all the players to play the updated demo and wishlist the game.

They can play the updated Demo on Steam !

Let's play! On October 11th and 13th at 20:00 CEST, there will be a stream of the developer of Legends of Castile playing the exclusive demo of the game for the Steam Next Fest and doing Q&A about the game!


Players can send their questions to the game social media with the hashtag #AskMeAboutLegendsOfCastile : Twitter/X


The demo is translated in English, Spanish and French languages, and it’s available on Windows, MAC OS and Linux platforms.




[h3]What is Legends of Castile game about?[/h3]

Legends of Castile is a point and click adventure game featuring an original fantasy/comedy story placed in Spain in the region called Castile, set in the 19th century, where a series of traditional legends about folk creatures take place.


In the game, you will be able to advance in the story by solving integrated riddles/puzzles, meeting all kind of characters, defeating mythological folk creatures with your wit and exploring places all around Castile.


[h3]Who is the protagonist of this story?[/h3]

Our main character is María, a young, fearless, though clumsy Castilian girl, who some days ago, just after a long night with her friends saw a vision of the Virgin Mary (or that's what she thought), and now, all of a sudden she wants to become a nun. Therefore, she went to a convent in Burgos and requested to be ordered as a nun.


However, it is not so simple, for being able to become a nun, her future mother superior assigns her a mission. She has to investigate the traditional mythological creatures of Castile, and collect an item from each of the creatures, in order to prove their existence so the abbot take action against them and finish with their threat to the population of Castile.. and Christianity.



More information at [url=www.legendsofcastile.com]www.legendsofcastile.com[/url]
